newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Maori electoral option dates set.
newsitem.headline: NZ Maori electoral option dates set.

text.p: Maori electors would have the option to enrol on either the general or Maori roll or change from one roll to another between April 28 and August 27, Justice Minister Doug Graham said on Thursday in a statement.

The "Maori option" is held regularly and is the first step in setting the new electoral boundaries. It determines the number of seats set aside for Maori in the next parliament and consequently the number of general seats.
Five of the 65 electoral seats in the current parliament are set aside for Maori. Another 12 MPs of Maori descent were elected through general seats or from party lists.
